# orly

> A turn-end gate for coding agents. At the end of every turn the recorded work is
> checked against the project's specs in one TypeSafe/Jev judge request, with facts
> decided in code; the agent keeps working until they hold. One file, `orly.ts`, run
> with bun. `orly judge` exits 0 = may stop, 2 = not done, 1 = could not run.

- [README](README.md): what it does, install, quick start, commands.
- [Install](docs/install.txt): the .orly layout, the API key, environment variables.
- [Writing specs](docs/specs.txt): the spec tree, rules for judgeable specs, goals, file evidence, checks.
- [The guard](docs/guard.txt): what counts as weakening the gate and where it is refused.
- [API](docs/api.txt): library exports, the Turn shape, the CLI contract, wiring a host hook.
- [Claude Code adapter](install/claude/adapter.ts): the shipped hook, registered by install/claude/hooks.json.
- [Codex CLI adapter](install/codex/adapter.ts): hook for ~/.codex/hooks.json; reads rollout transcripts.
- [Cursor adapter](install/cursor/adapter.ts): hook for .cursor/hooks.json, registered by install/cursor/hooks.json.
- [OpenCode plugin](install/opencode/plugin.ts) and [Pi extension](install/pi/extension.ts): in-process adapters.
